Task: Magnesium NVT Equilibration for melting
Description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Magnesium structure file and Embedded Atom Method potential file appropriate for MD simulations, equilibrate the system under NVT conditions with the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in x, y and z direction. Return the absolute path of the equilibrated structure file and the final density in g/cm^3.

{"density": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"density": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/structure.dat"}

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_structure_retrieval_subtask_melting_trial_1/structure.data

# Replicate system

# Initialize velocity
velocity all create 300.0 4928459 dist gaussian

# Define compute for temperature and pressure

compute mypress all pressure mytemp

fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
timestep 0.001

# Output settings
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp pe ke etotal press density

# Run NVT

# Write final structure
write_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/melting/brief/subtasks/magnesium_nvt_subtask_melting_trial_1/final_structure.data
